title: "Plotly Renderer"
description: "This is a plotly JSON renderer!"
date: "2026-03-26"
author: 
    - name: Wenyu Liu
      url: https://wenyuliu.ch/
      orcid: 0009-0008-8368-4685

format: 
  html:
    page-layout: full

include-in-header:
- text: |
    <script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-3.3.1.min.js"></script>
---


```{=html}

<div id="plotly-renderer">
<div id="sidebar">
   
    <div class="control-group">
        <label for="fileInput" class="group-label">Upload Plotly JSON</label>
        <input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".json">
    </div>

    <hr>

    <div class="control-group">
        <label class="group-label">Background Color</label>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:5px; align-items: center;">

        <form class="form">
            <input type="text" id="bgColor" class="form__input" placeholder="" value="#FFFFFF">
            <label for="bgColor" class="form__label">Color</label>
        </form>

        <form class="form">
            <input type="number" id="bgOpacity" class="form__input" placeholder="" step="0.1" min="0" max="1" value="0.0">
            <label for="bgOpacity" class="form__label">Opacity</label>
        </form>

        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
        <label class="group-label">Dimensions (px)</label>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:5px;">
            <form class="form">
                <input type="number" id="plotWidth" class="form__input" placeholder="" step="100">
                <label for="plotWidth" class="form__label">Width</label>
            </form>

            <form class="form">
                <input type="number" id="plotHeight" class="form__input" placeholder="" step="100">
                <label for="plotHeight" class="form__label">Height</label>
            </form>
        </div>
        
    </div>

    <div class="control-group">
        <label for="fontFamily" class="group-label">Font Family</label>
        <select id="fontFamily" onchange="updateLayout()">
            <option value="Arial">Arial</option>
            <option value="Courier New">Courier New</option>
            <option value="Times New Roman">Times New Roman</option>
            <option value="Verdana">Verdana</option>
            <option value="Georgia">Georgia</option>
            <option value="Trebuchet MS">Trebuchet MS</option>
        </select>
    </div>


    <button onclick="updateLayout()" class="plotly-renderer-button">Apply Change</button>

    
    <hr>

    <div style="display:flex; gap:5px; flex-direction: column">
        <button onclick="exportSVG()" class="file-export-button"> <i class="bi bi-filetype-svg"></i> Export SVG</button>

        <button onclick="exportPDF()" class="file-export-button"> <i class="bi bi-file-pdf"></i> Export PDF</button>

    </div>
</div>

<div id="main-content">
    <div id="plot-container"></div>
</div>

<script src="../svg-to-pdf/svg-to-pdf.js"> </script>
<script src="./plotly-renderer.js"> </script>


</div>
```
